dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Right, we need to organise the end-of-year celebration. I've already booked the garden area for May 30th.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Good. I'm going to bring speakers — I'll sort out the music playlist this week.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'll handle the food. I'm going to order from that Georgian place near the station.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I was thinking 4 p.m. The garden is free from 3, so we'll have time to set up.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I can be there by 2:30 to help. I'm not doing anything that afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I'll need someone to help collect the food order. Rustam?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Sure — where is it? I'll pick it up. Just tell me the address.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: I'm going to send everyone the details tonight. I'm working on a shared document right now.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Are we going to invite Professor Aidarov?

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: I was going to ask him this week. He helped so many of us this year.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Good idea. I'll also check if Daniyar is still in Uralsk — he might have left already.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: He told me he's leaving June 2nd. So he'll be here on the 30th.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Great. This is going to be a good evening. I'm actually looking forward to it.

dialogue.speaker: Kamila
dialogue.text: Me too. I can't believe we're nearly done with the year.

dialogue.speaker: Zhibek
dialogue.text: Okay — I'm going to send the document by 8 p.m. Check your messages everyone!
